𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐨𝐨𝐣𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐚 — 𝐈’𝐦 𝐏𝐨𝐨𝐣𝐚 𝐊𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐤, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮’𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐛𝐬𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐊𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐃𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐬, 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐃𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐃𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐡𝐮𝐚 (𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐀𝐧𝐢𝐦𝐞), 𝐲𝐨𝐮’𝐯𝐞 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐟𝐚𝐯𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐥!

snippet.title: Midnight Showing
snippet.description:
Hey! My name is Jakob, aka MidnightShowing. Welcome to my channel where I produce video essays on film.

The goal of this channel is to provided nuanced, interesting analysis on modern films, while shining a light on indie, international, and underseen pictures. My approach to analysis is to always ground it in conversation with the history of cinema, as well as a critical engagement with the world in which films are produced. If that's your thing, please consider subscribing! I truly enjoy engaging in good-faith discussions on film and look forward to seeing you in the comments section.

This is a passion project for me, and as such, I work on videos whenever I have the spare time. I aim to produce at least one video a month, but hope that with time I'll be able to produce even more.

snippet.title: Aesthetic Distance
snippet.description:
There is no single "correct" way to read a film—
but there are infinite ways to read it deeply.

At Aesthetic Distance, we ground ourselves in the work:
its structure, its context, its fabric of meaning.

Then we pull threads.
Your thread. Our thread.

Not the director's truth.
Not arbitrary feelings.
But interpretations rooted in what we see.

"The birth of the reader must be 
at the cost of the death of the Author."
— Roland Barthes

snippet.description:
Welcome to a channel dedicated to deep conceptual analysis of novels, films, plays, and philosophical ideas.
Here, we explore stories beyond the surface — uncovering meaning, symbolism, narrative structure, and philosophical questions hidden within literature and cinema. From classic novels and modern movies to theater, and critical theories, each video offers thoughtful interpretation and analytical insight.

If you are interested in film analysis, literary criticism, philosophy, narrative theory, symbolism, meaning, and the relationship between art and thought, this channel is for you. This is a space for slow thinking, close reading, and reflective viewing — where stories become tools for understanding the human condition.

Subscribe if you enjoy philosophical analysis of movies and books, conceptual discussions, and exploring how art shapes our understanding of reality, identity, freedom, and existence.

snippet.title: The Case Verdict
snippet.description:
Every case has two sides. Not every case has answers.

The Case Verdict is a documentary-style true crime channel 
dedicated to uncovering the stories behind the most 
compelling, disturbing, and unresolved criminal cases 
from around the world.

No sensationalism. No exploitation. Just the facts, 
the evidence, and the questions that keep investigators 
— and juries — up at night.

New case every week.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What we cover:
→ Unsolved murders
→ Wrongful convictions
→ Cold cases
→ Heists and con artists
→ Courtroom breakdowns

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Every verdict tells a story.
Not every story has a verdict.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Subscribe for new cases.
Turn on notifications — you won't want to miss one.
